prompt_text: Use the first reference only as an exact silhouette/camera template, repainting its two stair end-elevation cells in the style/material of references two and three. Render exactly four clean isolated cells in a 2-column by 2-row atlas on transparent background, no labels: FRONT and REAR columns; row 1 UP stairs, row 2 DOWN stairs. Every cell is a straight-on orthographic vertical END ELEVATION, a broad rectangular wall made from three horizontal white marble courses, blue shadowed joints, groundline at bottom. Absolutely no visible tread tops, no staircase plan, no cavity, no angled side returns, no isometric view. Show exactly TWO small gold square caps at the uppermost left/right ends only; do not repeat caps on lower courses, do not add extra gold squares or pillars. UP and DOWN stay distinct according to references. Keep the style crisp pixel art with black outlines; no shadows or other objects. Hidden rear construction may be inferred but must use the same marble and blue/gold source palette.
